seal.statement: A passing durable proof receipt (scripts/proof-authority.js recordProof) can only be recorded from a validated execution report of the exact candidate. The runner owns one report schema (candidate sha and release proof identity, producer, commands with exit statuses, planned vs executed vs skipped files, per-file results with assertion counts, retry record). recordProof refuses with typed problem codes an absent or partial report, a sha or identity mismatch, a failed or skipped planned file, a zero-assertion pass, a truncated corpus, a failed command, and a passed-on-retry file unless the sealed policy for that proof id admits qualified results, in which case the receipt carries the qualification and is never a clean pass. Existing lawful reuse (resolveProof, identity-catalogued proofs, append-only receipt history) is unchanged and old receipts are not reinterpreted.

Implemented at the existing owner. scripts/test-execution-report.js is the one schema owner (lagrange-test-execution-report/v1: candidate sha/tree/clean/identity, producer, commands with exit statuses, planned files, reused proofs, runner runs with per-file results, assertion counts and every retry attempt) with the writer and the validator executionReportProblems. scripts/run-test-files.js appends start/end sections when LAGRANGE_EXECUTION_REPORT names a file, keeping the first failure beside a retry pass, and strips that variable from every test file it spawns (a test's own nested runner is its fixture, not the proof: red-nested-runner-sections.log). scripts/proof-authority.js recordProof requires a report (CLI --report, exit 3 on refusal) and refuses with typed execution-report-* problems: absent, schema, partial, sha/tree mismatch, not clean, identity mismatch or unverifiable (recorder not in a clean checkout of the subject; replaces a sentinel identity), failed command, failed/truncated run, run in another checkout, planned file failed/not executed, zero-assertion pass, passed-on-retry (both contracts seal retryPolicy REFUSE), cited reused proof that does not resolve. A qualified receipt (outcome passed-qualified) is only possible under ADMIT_QUALIFIED and never resolves under a refusing contract; old receipts resolve unchanged.
